root_cause.text: The Seagate ST1000DM010-2EP102 hard drive has a firmware/hardware defect that causes system instability (random freezes) when Link Power Management (LPM) is enabled, and the kernel’s quirk list did not previously disable LPM for this model, leaving it exposed to the incompatible power saving behavior.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `ATA_QUIRK_NOLPM` for the `ST1000DM010-2EP102` model to the `__ata_dev_quirks` array in `drivers/ata/libata-core.c`. The commit message and CVE description explicitly state that this drive “has problems with LPM, causing random system freezes” and that it belongs to the same family as `ST2000DM008-2FR102`, which already had the same quirk. The fix is directly related to the missing quirk entry.
